schema_note: Data-driven lab-marker reference for T3 reasoning: turn a user's stored lab value into a known-science implication, tagged by the body systems it touches. Extend freely — a new marker is a JSON entry, no code. Ranges are typical adult reference intervals; implications are directional, NOT diagnoses. `aliases` let free-text/records resolve to a marker.

wbc.name: White blood cell count
wbc.low_implication: reduced immune defence — infections may be more frequent or slower to clear, and you may want to be more careful around sick contacts
wbc.high_implication: often reflects an active infection or inflammation at the time of the test
wbc.citation: Adult reference interval, common haematology guidance

neutrophils.name: Neutrophil count
neutrophils.low_implication: neutropenia lowers defence against bacterial infection specifically — low counts warrant more caution and a doctor's input
neutrophils.high_implication: commonly rises with acute bacterial infection or physical/inflammatory stress

vitamin_d.name: Vitamin D (25-OH)
vitamin_d.low_implication: low vitamin D is linked to more frequent infections, fatigue, and poorer sleep; it also interacts with immune and bone health
vitamin_d.high_implication: very high levels are usually from over-supplementation

ferritin.name: Ferritin (iron stores)
ferritin.low_implication: low iron stores commonly cause fatigue, reduced exercise tolerance, and can worsen how run-down you feel when fighting something off
ferritin.high_implication: high ferritin can reflect inflammation or iron overload

hba1c.name: HbA1c (3-month glucose)
hba1c.high_implication: elevated average glucose (>=5.7 pre-diabetic, >=6.5 diabetic range); high glucose also blunts immune function, which is one reason it can mean slower healing and more infections
hba1c.citation: ADA Standards of Care, HbA1c thresholds

fasting_glucose.name: Fasting glucose
fasting_glucose.low_implication: low-normal or below range — watch for hypoglycaemia symptoms
fasting_glucose.high_implication: elevated fasting glucose (>=100 impaired, >=126 diabetic range) points to insulin resistance

triglycerides.name: Triglycerides
triglycerides.high_implication: high triglycerides raise cardiovascular risk and often travel with insulin resistance and central weight gain

hdl.name: HDL cholesterol
hdl.low_implication: low HDL is a cardiovascular risk factor; it tends to rise with exercise and fall with inactivity

ldl.name: LDL cholesterol
ldl.high_implication: elevated LDL is a primary driver of cardiovascular risk over time

tsh.name: TSH (thyroid)
tsh.low_implication: low TSH can reflect an overactive thyroid — may show up as a fast heart rate, feeling wired, or poor sleep
tsh.high_implication: high TSH can reflect an underactive thyroid — may show up as fatigue, feeling cold, and weight gain

crp.name: C-reactive protein (inflammation)
crp.high_implication: elevated CRP signals active inflammation somewhere — could be an infection, or chronic low-grade inflammation that raises cardiovascular risk
